evidence.headline_yoy_pct: The Consumer Price Index (CPI) rose 1.6% on a year-over-year basis in September, down from a 2.0% gain in August.
evidence.headline_yoy_change_pp: The Consumer Price Index (CPI) rose 1.6% on a year-over-year basis in September, down from a 2.0% gain in August.
evidence.headline_mom_pct: On a monthly basis, the CPI fell 0.4% in September, after a 0.2% decline in August.
evidence.headline_mom_sa_pct: On a seasonally adjusted monthly basis, the CPI was unchanged at 0.0% in September.
evidence.cpi_ex_gas_yoy_pct: The all-items CPI excluding gasoline rose 2.2% in September, matching the increase in August for this measure.
